scope: loopback synthetic Chromium-family browser only; no shared cloud accessed

results.name: Upload acknowledgement lost remains idempotent
results.steps: Drop successful PUT response; retry original queued packet
results.expected: Server advances once only, local queue clears on retry, record unique
results.actual: Server advances once only, local queue clears on retry, record unique

results.name: A→B empty queue discovery and explicit merge
results.steps: A adds record; B checks; previews and explicitly merges
results.expected: Remote-only record downloaded once; local unchanged before confirmation; retained after merge
results.actual: Remote-only record downloaded once; local unchanged before confirmation; retained after merge

results.name: Unchanged checks are read-only and throttled
results.steps: Check twice, including immediate automatic recheck; count IndexedDB writes
results.expected: Only one diagnostics GET, no snapshot GET, zero puts/adds/deletes
results.actual: Only one diagnostics GET, no snapshot GET, zero puts/adds/deletes

results.name: Dirty B and shared-project conflict
results.input: A and B edit same project
results.steps: B commits unsynced edit; A syncs edit; B runs
results.expected: Both versions retained; no upload/overwrite by B
results.actual: Both versions retained; no upload/overwrite by B

results.name: Concurrent local edit during download
results.steps: Commit B edit during snapshot response
results.expected: No stale remote job staged; B edit and normal upload queue preserved
results.actual: No stale remote job staged; B edit and normal upload queue preserved

results.name: Lost response and retry
results.expected: First attempt preserves local; retry stages only one pending copy
results.actual: First attempt preserves local; retry stages only one pending copy

results.name: Version changes between diagnostics and download
results.input: A updates twice during B check
results.steps: Advance A after captured diagnostics response; retry B
results.expected: Mismatch blocks stale staging, next check stages newest revision
results.actual: Mismatch blocks stale staging, next check stages newest revision

results.name: Corrupt response rejected
results.steps: Change tag before client receives snapshot
results.expected: No staged snapshot or business write; original local preserved
results.actual: No staged snapshot or business write; original local preserved

results.name: Rollback and same-version hash mismatch blocked
results.steps: Return older cursor then same revision with different hash
results.expected: Both checks fail closed; no business writes or pending snapshot
results.actual: Both checks fail closed; no business writes or pending snapshot

results.name: Concurrent empty-queue checks stage one copy
results.steps: Two independent sync runners check simultaneously
results.expected: Atomic transaction stages one pending job and one remote snapshot
results.actual: Atomic transaction stages one pending job and one remote snapshot

results.name: Original integrity after confirmed receive
results.steps: B discovers, explicitly confirms, reads original and metadata
results.expected: Bytes, SHA-256, name, MIME, size and timestamp identical; no duplicate file references
results.actual: Bytes, SHA-256, name, MIME, size and timestamp identical; no duplicate file references

results.name: Pending review survives whole-browser restart
results.steps: Discover; close browser context; reopen same isolated profile
results.expected: Same cursor, snapshot, job ID and local data survive; no duplicate request/job
results.actual: Same cursor, snapshot, job ID and local data survive; no duplicate request/job
